ruleDefinitions.name: Execute MSDT Via Answer File
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "msdt.exe" using an answer file which is simulating the legitimate way of calling msdt via "pcwrun.exe" (For example from the compatibility tab)

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\msdt\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\WINDOWS\\\\diagnostics\\\\index\\\\PCWDiagnostic\\\.xml.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-af\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/af\\ .*"))) AND  NOT (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\pcwrun\\\.exe$"))
